usedFor: Render hosts your services, and Conversion Chats messages your team when “Deploy Finished” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Deploy Finished” in Render, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: Every finished deploy, live or failed, reaches your team as a message through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: “Deploy Finished” in Render is polling, so the message follows a scheduled check, not the deploy itself.
